name: the Dungeons
note: The instanced raid dungeons (handlers/dungeons.go, entity/dungeons.go; claude-notes/dungeon-world-20261112.md): the disc's own Tunarian zones of Blackburrow, Runnyeye (with Misty Thicket before its gate, the way in) and Guk, each where it stands on Tunaria; every raid, group or lone player that goes in fights in a copy of its own (an instance). The dungeons block is read by the server, never written into the file: each dungeon's key, name, the boxes its creatures stand in (the world's npcs rows inside them are its templates, tools/dungeons_20261112.py) and where a player sent in lands, facing the way in. The open edges are closed by cmd/worldedges' rocks (dungeons-edges.json). Built by cmd/worldbuild from the operator's disc.

zones.name: Blackburrow
zones.note: Tunaria cell (6, 6): the gnolls' burrow, a pit and its tunnels under the hills round (12900, 12400)

zones.name: Misty Thicket
zones.note: Tunaria cell (8, 5): the valley before Runnyeye's gate, where its raids land; its own creatures are not in world 14

zones.name: Runnyeye
zones.note: Tunaria cell (8, 6): the goblins' warren in the valley's end (16250-16450, 12040-12320), King Merdid's halls, and Xorbb's pit to the south-east

zones.name: Guk
zones.note: Tunaria cell (12, 14): the froglok city, its gate and upper halls at (24850-25050, 29200-29470) and its sunken halls north under the swamp

dungeons.name: Guk
